description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Pakistan working-day offset. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when this package covers the nationwide federal public-holiday layer only. It is not a universal provincial, territory, private-employer, bank, exchange, school, court, diplomatic-mission or sector calendar. Lunar festival dates are pinned to the later federal notifications available for 2026; conflicting exchange or diplomatic calendars are retained as scoped cross-checks and not generalized.
What it computes: Adds or subtracts Pakistan authority-scope working days in exact coverage.
Example user requests: Add or subtract Pakistan working days around Pakistan Day. | Add or subtract Pakistan working days around Ordinary federal working day.
Inputs: start_date (date); working_days (integer).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-01-01","working_days":0}
Outputs: start_date, result_date, working_days_added, calendar_days_elapsed, public_holidays_skipped, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: move one day at a time; decrement only on status.is_working_day=true
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/pakistan-public-add-working-days with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/pakistan-public-add-working-days.md

working_days.description: Signed offset; start date excluded for non-zero offsets.

name: add_pk_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Pakistan 2026 nationwide federal public-holiday layer over a Saturday-Sunday federal-office baseline

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

substitute_day_policy.description: published_federal_dates_only; no automatic weekend_lieu_day; lunar dates and later Cabinet notifications override the annual estimate

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Add Pakistan Working Days
